notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Mostly tile placement fixes
notes.content:
Bugfixes

 FIXED: Polar stations do not get positive effect from penguins when they are in pastures
 FIXED: Bug caused by previous patch which enabled the new planet button too early starting with second planet
 FIXED: Tile placement still going on while selecting packages or in another menu
 FIXED: Tile preview not always going away after selecting a different tile for placement


Other changes

 UPDATE: Highscore will now be saved in Steam any time you enter the main menu
 UPDATE: Settings are now saved in the savegame

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Mostly bugfixes for Animal effects and localization
notes.content:
Hi all and thanks for beginning to play my game :)
I found the following bugs over the first days while watching streams / videos and now fixed them (Keep creating videos so I can debug even further!)

Bugfixes

 FIXED: Camels and penguins were not affected by all relevant tiles around them
 UPDATE: penguins now officially don't have effect by pastures (just the other way around)
 FIXED: If you get below 100% pollution without a tile which changes your points balance (e.g. a forest), the new planet button will now correctly show up
 FIXED: Starting a new game did not work when you close the game during the game over screen, restart the game and click on new highscore game


Translation updates

 FIXED: Llama not translated correctly
 FIXED: Game over screen points not translated correctly

notes.title: Demo v0.4 - New quest types
notes.content:
General changes


Added information about quests when hovering over them
Updated how coins fly towards the package overview
Added credits
Added support for tiles with bigger score range
Zoom is now smoother
New quest types:
    Place tiles of a specific tile group
    Connected tiles


New / updated tiles


added watering animation for fields
added mall as first tile getting score changes from not only immediate neighbors

notes.title: Demo v0.3 - Coming to life update
notes.content:
General changes

- Added robots moving around on tiles
- Updated tile info to show nicer on which biomes tiles can be placed (if limited)
- Added ability to place pastures and animals on them
- Minor UI changes
- Increased difficulty, especially after each planet switch

New buildings / tiles

- Research station
- Animal farm
- Pasture
- Cows
- Llamas

Bugfixes

- Fixed bug that score was wrongly displayed after reverting a tile placement
- fixed bug that forests and palms could be placed on existing forests / palms
- fixed display bug showing slightly negative percentages for score and pollution on planet switch

Bugfixes

notes.title: Demo v0.2 - Pollution effects
notes.content:
General changes

+ Added pollution on the planet (you now need to balance out good building strategy vs. high pollution)
+ Made UI smoother and changed default font
+ Slightly reduced difficulty


Buildings / Tiles

+ Forest / palms (now placeable)
+ Air cleaner building

Bugfixes
- Fixed wrong point flying on different resolutions
- German localization now uses proper umlauts

notes.title: Demo v0.1.1 - Biomes and ocean
notes.content:
Thanks for everyone giving feedback on the demo so far!
This update is a first step to improve the demo and add more details to the game.

General changes
+ added polar and desert biome to the earth planet type
+ rotation now follows the planet axis to keep camera orientation
+ increased difficulty
- removed full desert and full ice planet

Buildings / Tiles
+ added fish (randomly generated on the planet)
+ added fishing boat
+ added palms
+ added oasis

Bugfixes
- new packages button only works when packages are available
- fixed bug showing a tutorial part too early
